children: EQUASENS ACTIVATES BUSINESS CONTINUITY PLAN FOR ITS SUBSIDIARY ASCA IN CHESSY
ON EVENING OF SEPTEMBER 21, 2026, A FIRE BROKE OUT AT THIS SITE
HEADQUARTERS AND WAREHOUSE OF ITS SUBSIDIARY ASCA AFFECTED BY A FIRE, SOURCE OF WHICH HAS NOW BEEN EXTINGUISHED.
BUILDING AND INVENTORY STORED INSIDE WERE DESTROYED, NO INJURIES
25 ASCA EMPLOYEES RECEIVING SUPPORT; REMOTE WORK AND REDUCED HOURS IMPLEMENTED
BACKUP STOCK, ALREADY AVAILABLE ON ANOTHER OF GROUP'S STORAGE PLATFORMS, WILL ENSURE BUSINESS CONTINUITY OVER NEXT FEW DAYS
